en.title: 6th Maldives Marine Science Symposium 2026
en.description: The Maldives Marine Research Institute (MMRI) has announced the presentation themes for the 6th Maldives Marine Science Symposium. The symposium will feature research and discussions on Coral Reefs, Restoration and Climate Change; Fisheries Governance and Society; Sea Turtle Ecology, Health and Conservation; Sharks, Rays and Other Megafauna; and Coastal Ecosystems and Seabirds.

en.title: Seaside Stories - Art Exhibition
en.description: Join us for an art exhibition titled “Seaside Stories – Celebrating Fisheries through Art” that honors our nation’s connection with the sea. Explore unique and original works by talented artists, all centered around the themes of fisheries diversification and the importance of nurturing a new generation of fishers.

dv.title: ކުރެހުމުގެ މަޢުރަޒު
dv.description: މިނިސްޓްރީއާ މޯލްޑިވިއަން އާޓިސްޓް ކޮމިއުނިޓީ ގުޅިގެން ރާއްޖޭގެ ކުރެހުންތެރިންގެ ހުނަރުވެރިކަން ދައްކުވައިދިނުމުގެ ގޮތުން ބޭއްވޭ މި މައުރަޒުގައި ކުރެހުމާއި، ސްކަލްޕްޗަރ އާއި އަދިވެސް އެހެނިހެން އާޓް މީޑިއަމް މެދުވެރިކޮށް ދިވެހިންނާ މަސްވެރިކަމާ ހުރި ގުޅުން ރަމްޒުކޮށްދޭ މަސައްކަތްތައް ފެނިގެންދާނެއެވެ.
